model.name: RbStrip.renderDescriptors
model.description: renderDescriptors(descriptors: StripDescriptor[]): builds the ordered row from the descriptor array - compartment -> hosts rb-compartment, bar -> hosts a bar element - diff/patch on re-set (idempotent, like rb-trace-tree items). Landscape flex-row default; segment-building is a private helper INSIDE this method (not its own Method).
